title: Prepare Review URL (Skill trigger)
instructions:
## Purpose
Review how the coding agent prepares a non-empty, validated artifact and hands its local review URL to the reviewer.

## Regeneration
Inspect skills/architecture-companion/SKILL.md, specs/agent-handoff-architecture.spec.ts, and the view-generators, validate-schemas, and serve CLI commands. Reconstruct the new-artifact preparation flow from generator discovery and authoring through the non-empty artifact check, validation and correction loop, server startup, and URL handoff. Keep this diagram focused on preparation rather than the subsequent interactive review.

nodes.title: Receive an architecture review request
nodes.description: The coding agent starts preparing a review for the designated consumer scope.

nodes.title: Discover available generators
nodes.description: The agent harness discovers built-in, global, and project generator manifests.

nodes.title: Write the artifact
nodes.description: Write behavior and design diagram files following the common writing rules, the chosen generator's guidance, and the schemas.

nodes.title: Run the Architecture Companion server
nodes.description: Start the server for the designated scope and print the loopback URL.

nodes.title: Does the artifact contain diagrams and pass validation?
nodes.description: Confirm that at least one diagram exists across behaviors and designs, then validate the artifact with validate-schemas before sharing a URL.

nodes.title: Complete or fix the artifact
nodes.description: Add the requested diagrams if none exist. Fix validation errors and rerun the command until it prints Artifact is valid.

nodes.title: Hand off review URL
nodes.description: Explain what the validated artifact covers and hand the review URL to the reviewer.
